rv.q: Its uncertain opening and confusing visual choices are frustrating, but the later acts bring the acting, lighting, ensemble and music together with spectacular effect.
This production feels little more than a semi-staged concert on a narrow, framed traverse, leaving much of the Coliseum's stage depth wasted.

cn.t: ENO's French-language production of Gluck's masterwork receives a lukewarm reception, with critics finding the modernized directorial approach less successful than hoped despite the opera's esteemed reputation.
